public_rationale: Original testing in March 2024 documents repeated, material errors from New York City’s public chatbot. That supports the ordinary reading of Marcus’s criticism of the city’s experience about a year earlier.
limitations: The source reports occasional correct answers as well; it does not establish a representative overall error rate.
The report does not establish that users acted on the false advice.
The service launched in October 2023; 2024 is the period of documented failures, not its launch year.
The primary launch page was inaccessible, so the assessment relies on original investigative reporting.
